description.value: What remained on the northern side of the 2274 terrace fire, after a weave was cut in two by a burn a hundred metres wide and the halves stopped being able to signal across it. The southern portion continued to attend assembly and to answer to the whole name; this one grazed, held its boundary and sent nothing after 2281. Whether it was one self, two selves or a bereavement is the standing question of the species entry, and this record is the only case anybody has been able to watch.

notes.value: The end year is the last recorded exchange, not a determination of death. The field has no other value available, and the 2299 revision considered leaving it null and decided that would be a claim as well.
